events.text: Wubri renamed the area Wage sabre soba koumbem tenga, meaning head war chiefs village.

evidence.quote: until 1441 when Wubri , a Yonyonse hero and an important figure in Burkina Fasos history , led his tribe to victory

events.label: capital
events.text: The city became the capital of the Mossi Empire.

evidence.quote: The city became the capital of the Mossi Empire in 1441

events.text: Ouagadougou became the permanent residence of the Mossi emperors.

evidence.quote: became the permanent residence of the Mossi emperors ( Moro-Naba ) in 1681

events.label: capital
events.text: The French made Ouagadougou capital of the Upper Volta territory.

evidence.quote: In 1919 the French made Ouagadougou the capital of the Upper Volta territory

events.label: rail
events.text: The railroad line from Ivory Coast reached the city.

evidence.quote: In 1954 the railroad line from Ivory Coast reached the city

events.label: election
events.text: Ouagadougou held its first municipal elections.

evidence.quote: Ouagadougous first municipal elections were held in 1956

events.label: communal status
events.text: Ouagadougou became a veritable communal centre.

evidence.quote: became a veritable communal centre in 1995

events.label: attack
events.text: Gunmen attacked central Ouagadougou restaurant and hotel; 28 killed.

evidence.quote: On 15 January 2016 , gunmen armed with heavy weapons attacked central Ouagadougou

undated_mentions: 15th century: the name Ouagadougou dates back to the period when the Ninsi tribes inhabited the area
